<?php
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$a = trim(fgets(STDIN));

$map = [
    '0' => '',
    '1' => '',
    '2' => '2',
    '3' => '3',
    '4' => '322',
    '5' => '5',
    '6' => '53',
    '7' => '7',
    '8' => '7222',
    '9' => '7332'
];

$result = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($a); $i++) {
    $digit = $a[$i];
    if (isset($map[$digit]) && $map[$digit] !== '') {
        $chars = str_split($map[$digit]);
        foreach ($chars as $c) {
            $result[] = $c;
        }
    }
}

rsort($result);
echo implode('', $result);
?>

<?php
// Read input
$n = intval(trim(fgets(STDIN)));
$a = trim(fgets(STDIN));

// Mapping based on factorial digit decomposition
$map = [
    '0' => '',
    '1' => '',
    '2' => '2',
    '3' => '3',
    '4' => '322',
    '5' => '5',
    '6' => '53',
    '7' => '7',
    '8' => '7222',
    '9' => '7332'
];

$resultDigits = [];

// Decompose each digit according to the mapping
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    $digit = $a[$i];
    if (isset($map[$digit]) && $map[$digit] !== '') {
        $chars = str_split($map[$digit]);
        foreach ($chars as $ch) {
            $resultDigits[] = $ch;
        }
    }
}

// Sort digits in descending order to form the maximum number
rsort($resultDigits);

// Output the result
echo implode('', $resultDigits);
?>
